# laravelforge_server_php_opcache (Resource)

Enables PHP OPcache on a Laravel Forge server. This is a singleton toggle: creating the resource enables OPcache, destroying it disables OPcache. There is no in-place update.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to enable PHP OPcache on.

### Read-Only

- `opcache_enabled` (Boolean) Whether PHP OPcache is enabled on the server.
